title: 16 injured in Negombo Prison clash; STF deployed to restore order - Breaking News | Daily Mirror
summary:
Colombo, July 5 (Daily Mirror) - At least 16 inmates were injured following a clash between two groups of prisoners at the Negombo Prison, police said.

According to the Director of the Negombo Hospital, all 16 injured inmates were admitted to the hospital for treatment after the unrest inside the prison.

In response to the incident, authorities deployed the Police Special Task Force (STF) to assist in bringing the situation under control.

title: Missing service weapon of Yatiyantota Traffic OIC recovered from Kelani River - Breaking News | Daily Mirror
summary:
Colombo, July 5 (Daily Mirror) - The official service firearm belonging to the Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the Traffic Branch of the Yatiyantota Police, which had been reported missing, has been recovered from the Kelani River.

According to the police, a stock of ammunition was also retrieved from the river along with the weapon.

The Traffic OIC was arrested on June 28 on charges of failing to properly hand over his official service firearm and 10 rounds of ammunition. Following his arrest, he was produced before the Ruwanwella Magistrate's Court and subsequently remanded in custody.
